rejection_class_moved.v16_class: declared_fact_missing_from_rendered_answer: 32 of 32 retries, each missing exactly one registered required literal
rejection_class_moved.v17_class: over_160_chars: 2 of 2 retries, and v17_first_missing_required_literals is empty in both
rejection_class_moved.reading: the root-cause class disappeared and the length bound became the binding class instead, which is the expected consequence of the new prompt sentence: the model now puts all three required literals inside cause and fix, which lengthens those fields, and the first candidate line then exceeds 160 characters
rejection_class_moved.not_a_regression_in_quality: both length rejections were repaired by the single retry, so all nine samples still pass the strict track; the trade is visible in the retry rate, not in quality
rejection_class_moved.implication_for_the_next_configuration: the 160 character bound is now the first-attempt bottleneck, so any new task shape must keep the number of required literals small and must check the minimum feasible rendered line before the batch is frozen

integrity_gap_owned.what: the v17 pilot run cannot be tied to an exact code revision
evidence: the v17 freeze names only the renderer hash (experiments/runners/openai_agents_structured_final_v16.py, 22fa96a5...), which is unchanged and verified
the pilot-02 manifest records host_configuration.modules as an empty object, so no module revision was pinned by the run

the diff artifact records the runner target as ba5cedef511fcd3f while the file on disk now hashes to be0b97b4100711e7, so the runner was edited after that target was recorded (the finalisation bug fix) and nothing states which revision produced the numbers
the registry and live-contract targets do still match the files on disk (aa67abea06d9a47b and b5be9165c8845579)
integrity_gap_owned.impact: bounded: the batch is non-citable development evidence by its own freeze, so no citable claim rests on it; the effect is on reproducibility, not on any published number
remediation_mandatory_for_the_next_run: the next freeze must list host_configuration.modules with a sha256 for every module in the path, exactly as the v16 freeze did
the manifest must copy those hashes and a revision-aware fail-closed check must refuse the batch if any recorded hash no longer matches the file
the freeze and the driver modules must be frozen before the first paid request of the batch, and the batch id must be new

post_hoc_provenance_recorded_now.note: these hashes were taken after the run; they are provenance records, not pre-registered pins, and the runner hash differs from the diff artifact's target

may_be_stated: under this host configuration, the one-sentence prompt completeness fix removed the rejection class that produced all 32 repair retries in the sealed confirmation batch, and in this nine-sample development pilot first-attempt acceptance rose from 28.9 percent to 77.8 percent while every sample kept passing the strict track and the length bound became the only remaining rejection class
may_not_be_stated: any saving claim from this pilot
that the retry tax is gone or that 77.8 percent generalises
anything about other hosts or other host configurations
